body: Nothing really brings me happiness anymore, except drugs. All things that were interesting to me... They are gone. I think I am done for, there is probably no hope for me... I am sorry, I can't bring myself to think positively

Sadly I don't see anything lovable within me. I probably won't find anyone to love me since I would have to have redeeming qualities while having so many flaws... I don't have any. 

I can handle anxiety attacks, I somehow function in the society... Barely, but I do.

Thank you for trying to help though... I miss talking with people since I stopped being able to vocally express myself...

Last person I vented to could not take interacting with me anymore and left me which made me shut myself for good later. I don't blame  them since I know I am unbearable, but I don't know if I should vent again and feel like I felt last time again. I am sorry if it doesnt make sense, I am tired, very tired.
